continuation.text:
I didn't change `src/solution.py`, and I didn't run it or any checks.

The withdrawn rule said at least one resource must stay unallocated. The code doesn't enforce that. It only returns `False` when total usage is strictly greater than capacity (`used > resources[name]`). An allocation that uses all of a resource's capacity is still feasible.
